ANTLR C++ runtime 4.13.2, unmodified upstream source distribution.
Source: https://www.antlr.org/download/antlr4-cpp-runtime-4.13.2-source.zip
SHA256: 0ed13668906e86dbc0dcddf30fdee68c10203dea4e83852b4edb810821bee3c4

The archive is extracted locally by CMake. Builds need no network or Java.
Generated lexer/parser sources use the matching ANTLR 4.13.2 generator.
